title: Disclosure Day
plot_overview: A cybersecurity expert becomes a whistleblower after uncovering classified secrets about alien life, forcing him to flee a powerful corporation. A meteorologist experiencing strange phenomena joins him, and together they race to reveal the truth while confronting forces determined to keep it hidden.
will_you_like_this: You may enjoy this if you like conspiracy-driven science fiction, Spielberg-style wonder, and tense escapes, but Not for you if you dislike long runtimes, dense dialogue, or unresolved questions.
review_summary: Pros: intriguing alien mystery; strong lead performances; hopeful themes | Cons: overly long runtime; uneven pacing; heavy exposition
